item.title: New recipe: Aurora: Northern Lights Forecast
item.description: Created by community member nikokoren. Enable and keep checking for cheap flights to Norway.
item.content:encoded:
Aurora: Northern Lights Forecast : No more guessing at the night sky.

By IsarWorks · education, discovery

Created by community member nikokoren. Enable and keep checking for cheap flights to Norway.

TRMNL announcement

From the author (About This Plugin)

Ever step outside on a whim and just happen to catch the northern lights? Neither have we.

Aurora is here to help. It reads real space weather data from NOAA and tells you straight: are the northern lights actually visible from where you are, tonight and the two nights after. When the answer is no, it just says so.

Pick the abstract halftone chart or a real map centered on your own sky, and choose your voice: plain and factual, or a space physicist who has a hard time staying calm once the numbers turn good.

Install (don't Fork!) to receive future updates.
<br><br>Aurora turns real space weather data into a straight answer: is the aurora actually visible tonight from wherever you live? It reads live geomagnetic activity from NOAA's space weather service and checks it against your own location and the darkness there right now, then tells you plainly whether conditions are good, and for how long.<br><br>Beyond right now, it also gives a three night outlook, so you know whether it is worth staying up tonight or better to wait for a stronger night. Every screen shows a verdict, a viewing window when there is one, and which direction to face.<br><br>See the forecast as an abstract halftone chart of aurora activity around the pole, or as a real oriented map centered on your own sky. Pick the voice you want it in: plain and factual, or an excited space physicist who can barely contain themselves once the numbers turn good.<br><br>Works from either hemisphere, not just the usual northern only aurora tools, and is fully available in English and German. Built entirely on TRMNL's native framework, so it fits any screen size and orientation without extra configuration.

Install the recipe on trmnl.com

item.title: New recipe: Texas Power Grid
item.description: Created by community member . Enable and even the recipes are bigger from Texas.
item.content:encoded:
Texas Power Grid : Charts related to the ERCOT grid

By Creator #35331 · news, analytics

Created by community member . Enable and even the recipes are bigger from Texas.

TRMNL announcement

From the author (About This Plugin)

The "Texas Power Grid" plugin shows a collection of ERCOT information including wind and solar generation, system-wide prices, energy storage resource output, and ancillary services. The display shown on the TRMNL device and be chosen via the dropdown below. This plugin is not affiliated with ERCOT Inc. and uses publicly available data.<br><br>This plugin displays charts and metrics for the ERCOT interconnection, the power grid serving most of Texas.<br><br>Use the Display option to choose from the following views:<br><br>• Wind and Solar: Actual wind and solar generation for today, plus forecasts through the end of tomorrow. Series can be stacked or overlaid.<br><br>• System-Wide Prices: Individual plots of hub and load zone prices, comparing today's real-time price with the day-ahead price. An all-prices view summarizes every hub and load zone in a single display.<br><br>• Energy Storage: Fleet-wide behavior of Energy Storage Resources (ESRs). Optional toggles add a "net energy" line showing cumulative ESR energy as a proxy for state of charge, and a box plot overlay comparing current behavior to the previous 30 days.<br><br>• Ancillary Services: Regulation services over the past two hours.

item.title: New recipe: Now Printing (Cloud)
item.description: By Creator #37780 · Bambu Lab prints, with pictures
item.content:encoded:
Now Printing (Cloud) : Bambu Lab prints, with pictures

By Creator #37780 · productivity, personal

From the author (About This Plugin)

What your Bambu Lab printer is making, with the model's own picture, and the prints before it: print time, filament, material, when each one finished. Everything comes from your Bambu Lab cloud history, so nothing has to run on your own computer.<br/><br/> <b>Setup.</b> Paste your Bambu Lab access token into the field below. To get it, sign in at <a href="https://makerworld.com" class="underline">makerworld.com</a>, open your browser's developer tools, go to Application (Chrome) or Storage (Firefox), then Cookies, then makerworld.com, and copy the value of <b>token</b>. A token lasts about 90 days. When the screen asks for it again, repeat this.<br/><br/> <b>Limits.</b> Prints started from the printer's SD card are not in Bambu's cloud history, so they do not appear. A running print shows up when this plugin's turn in your playlist comes. The plugin reads Bambu's unofficial cloud API, which Bambu may change.<br/><br/> Made by <a href="https://tactus.works" class="underline">tactus.works</a>.

item.description: By IsarWorks · Bike share availability
item.content:encoded:
Nearby Nextbike : Bike share availability

By IsarWorks · discovery, life

From the author (About This Plugin)

<br>Ever stood at the door wondering whether to run for the bus or grab a share bike instead? Nearby Nextbike shows you exactly where the bikes are right now.<br>
<br>It puts a live map on your TRMNL, centred on your front door, showing every bike within a twenty minute walk. Walking distances are drawn right on the map, based on your map settings. Filled pins are stations, hollow pins are bikes someone parked on the street, and a small number on a pin means several bikes in one spot. If almost nothing is close by, arrows at the edge of the map point to bikes just out of frame, with the walk time and number of bikes in that direction. A bike four minutes past the edge is still worth knowing about if you were heading that way anyway.<br>
<br>Prefer words to pictures? Set "What the screens show" to *Text*. Instead of a map, you get the closest bike, where it is, and how long it takes to walk there, which works especially well in cities with station based bike sharing.<br>
<br>Works anywhere nextbike operates: over 200 systems in 21 countries. Many run under local brand names, so you may already be using nextbike without knowing it.<br><br>
Germany: <br>MyRadl (Munich), KVB Rad (Cologne), VAG_Rad (Nuremberg), Frelo (Freiburg), Bre.Bike (Bremen), VRNnextbike (Rhine-Neckar), KVV.nextbike (Karlsruhe), euregiobike (Aachen), Potsdam Rad, wupsiRad (Leverkusen), UsedomRad, StadtRad Greifswald, MV-Rad, and nextbike in Berlin, Leipzig, Hannover, Düsseldorf, Kassel, Wiesbaden, Marburg, Gießen and the Ruhrgebiet.<br><br>
Austria: <br>WienMobil Rad, Stadtrad Innsbruck, city bike Linz, VMOBIL Rad, VVT REGIORAD Tirol, nextbike Klagenfurt and Niederösterreich.<br><br>
Poland: <br>VETURILO 3.0 (Warsaw), Łódzki Rower Publiczny, METROROWER, Toruński Rower Miejski, Opole Bike, BIKER Białystok and many more city systems.<br><br>
Czechia and Slovakia: <br>nextbike in Prague, Brno, Ostrava, Liberec, Hradec Králové and dozens of smaller towns, plus nextbike Bratislava, Arriva Bike and BikeKI

item.description: By Creator #36849 · Official forecast, no API key
item.content:encoded:
German Weather Service (DWD) : Official forecast, no API key

By Creator #36849 · environment, nature

From the author (About This Plugin)

Weather for anywhere in Germany from the <strong>Deutscher Wetterdienst</strong>
(DWD), the national meteorological service: an hourly timeline, plus an outlook
of up to five days. Missing data reads as a dash, never a zero.
<br><br>
<strong>Setup.</strong> Search for your town in the Location field, or paste a
comma-separated latitude and longitude, then save the form once. The forecast
is kept on your account's own timezone, so there is nothing else to set. No API
key and no server — TRMNL polls
<a href="https://brightsky.dev/">Bright Sky</a> hourly and builds the card
in-platform.
<br><br>
<strong>Source.</strong> The forecast is DWD's, taken through Bright Sky, an
open JSON API over <a href="https://opendata.dwd.de/">DWD Open Data</a>. DWD's
terms of use govern the data. Bright Sky is independently operated and not
endorsed by DWD, so this recipe cannot promise its availability.
<br><br>
<strong>No weather warnings.</strong> DWD asks that its attribution be removed
from warnings unless they are delivered complete and without delay, which an
hourly refresh cannot promise. Forecast only.
<br><br>
<strong>Screens.</strong> All four layouts are built for TRMNL OG and for
TRMNL X in both landscape and portrait. TRMNL X landscape carries a longer
hourly timeline than the other two; portrait turns the outlook into a
day-per-row list.
